title: Rest, pool, lounge supper, Nathan Road markets
summary: Breakfast from 8am, then rest and pool time. Lounge at the hotel for drinks and supper from 17:30, then walk up Nathan Road to the markets. Big Buddha / Ngong Ping moved to Friday morning.

rows.what: Walk to markets up Nathan Road
rows.detail: From the hotel up Nathan Road for the night markets / Temple Street area. Casual stroll after supper.

notes: Shifted to Friday morning after breakfast. Peak already done Wednesday.
